declared_programs.all-opaque:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (objs (objects g 0))
         (cyan (find (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8)) objs)))
    (if (not cyan) g
      (let* ((cr1 (obj-r1 cyan)) (cc1 (obj-c1 cyan))
             (cr2 (obj-r2 cyan)) (cc2 (obj-c2 cyan))
             (blockers (filter (lambda (o) (!= (obj-color o) 8)) objs))
             (base (reduce (lambda (gg r)
                     (let* ((left-lim (reduce (lambda (acc b)
                                        (let ((bb (obj-bbox b)))
                                          (if (and (<= (nth bb 0) r) (<= r (nth bb 2)) (< (nth bb 3) cc1))
                                            (max acc (nth bb 1)) acc)))
                                      0 blockers))
                            (right-lim (reduce (lambda (acc b)
                                         (let ((bb (obj-bbox b)))
                                           (if (and (<= (nth bb 0) r) (<= r (nth bb 2)) (> (nth bb 1) cc2))
                                             (min acc (nth bb 3)) acc)))
                                       (- w 1) blockers)))
                       (reduce (lambda (gg2 c)
                                 (if (and (>= c left-lim) (<= c right-lim) (not (and (>= c cc1) (<= c cc2))))
                                   (set-cell gg2 r c 4) gg2))
                               gg (range 0 w))))
                   g (range cr1 (+ cr2 1))))
             (base2 (reduce (lambda (gg c)
                      (let* ((up-lim (reduce (lambda (acc b)
                                       (let ((bb (obj-bbox b)))
                                         (if (and (<= (nth bb 1) c) (<= c (nth bb 3)) (< (nth bb 2) cr1))
                                           (max acc (nth bb 0)) acc)))
                                     0 blockers))
                             (down-lim (reduce (lambda (acc b)
                                          (let ((bb (obj-bbox b)))
                                            (if (and (<= (nth bb 1) c) (<= c (nth bb 3)) (> (nth bb 0) cr2))
                                              (min acc (nth bb 2)) acc)))
                                        (- h 1) blockers)))
                        (reduce (lambda (gg2 r)
                                  (if (and (>= r up-lim) (<= r down-lim) (not (and (>= r cr1) (<= r cr2))))
                                    (set-cell gg2 r c 4) gg2))
                                gg (range 0 h))))
                    base (range cc1 (+ cc2 1))))
             (base3 (reduce (lambda (gg cell) (set-cell gg (first cell) (second cell) 8))
                            base2 (obj-cells cyan))))
        (reduce (lambda (gg b)
                  (reduce (lambda (gg2 cell) (set-cell gg2 (first cell) (second cell) (obj-color b)))
                          gg (obj-cells b)))
                base3 blockers))))))
